title: Emmunyeenye Ekkumi n’emu Ezaafukamidde
intro: Ekifaananyi okuva mu Quran yaweebwa okwolesebwa okw’amaanyi mu buto — ekirooto ky’ebintu eby’omu ggulu nga bifukamira mu kitiibwa. Emyaka gyandiyise mu nkwe, okwawukana, okulumiriza eby’obulimba, n’okusibwa ng’okwolesebwa kuno tekunnatuukirira. Omwoyo guno ogugumira embeera y’ani ng’emboozi ye ekwata essuula esinga obuwanvu mu Quran?
clues: Lumu nnali muto, nga nfunye omukisa n’ekirooto ekyewuunyisa ne taata yennyini kye yandabula okukuuma nga kya kyama.
Baganda bange bennyini, nga bazibye amaaso olw’obuggya, bankola olukwe ne bansuula mu luzzi oluwanvu era olw’ekizikiza.
Nnatwalibwa mu nsi ey’ewala ne ntundibwa mu maka g’omukungu ow’ekitiibwa, gye nnafuna okusiimibwa era ne nsituka mu buvunaanyizibwa.
Okulumiriza okw’obulimba kwanviirako okusibwa mu ngeri etali ya bwenkanya, naye ate mu kifo ekyo eky’ekizikiza nnafuna okubudaabudibwa mu kusaba n’okuvunnama eri Allah.
Allah yampa omukisa n’obusobozi obutatera kubaawo obw’okuvvuunula ebirooto, okukkakkana nga bintuusizza mu maaso g’omufuzi w’ensi n’ansitula okutuuka ku kifo eky’oku ntikko eky’okwesiga.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi nga twawukana, nnaddamu okukwatagana n’ab’omu maka gange gwe nnali njagala ennyo, era ekirooto kyange eky’obuto eky’emmunyeenye kkumi n’emu, enjuba n’omwezi nga binfukamidde ku nkomerero kyatuukirira.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
